verdict.rationale: CockroachDB documents multi-region capabilities with per-table locality and database survival goals, and a community user ties multi-region directly to data residency. However, the evidence never explicitly documents pinning data to a chosen region for residency, or selecting a cloud region when creating a cluster. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on region selection and data-domiciling/residency guarantees, cloud cluster region choice, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: CockroachDB multi-region capabilities make it easier to run global applications.
_Table locality_ determines how CockroachDB optimizes access to a table's data.
Data residency is the whole point...
